# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo run --bin oxterm-docgen`; do not edit. -->

Oxterm reads `~/.config/oxterm/settings.json` (or the file given with
`--config FILE`). Keys not listed here are ignored. Use
`oxterm --show-config` to print the effective values, `oxterm
--show-config --default` for the built-in defaults, and `oxterm
--validate-config [FILE]` to check a file without starting a window.

Values can be overridden for one session with `-o KEY=VALUE` (repeatable)
or loaded from a profile with `-p NAME`. Command line overrides are
never written back to disk.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `font_name` | string | `Monospace` | Font family used by new terminals. |
| `font_size` | int (4..128) | `12` | Font size in points. |
| `color_scheme` | string | `Dark (Default)` | Built-in color scheme; see --list-themes. |
| `auto_theme` | bool | `false` | Follow the desktop's light/dark preference, using theme_light or theme_dark. |
| `theme_light` | string | `Light` | Theme used when the desktop prefers a light appearance. |
| `theme_dark` | string | `Dark (Default)` | Theme used when the desktop prefers a dark appearance. |
| `foreground_color` | color or empty | `""` | Foreground override; empty uses the color scheme. |
| `background_color` | color or empty | `""` | Background override; empty uses the color scheme. |
| `cursor_color` | color (#rrggbb) | `#ffffff` | Cursor color. |
| `cursor_shape` | string | `block` | Cursor shape for new terminals. |
|  |  | Values: `block`, `underline`, `ibeam` |  |
| `highlight_color` | color (#rrggbb) | `#ffffff` | Foreground of selected text. |
| `highlight_bg_color` | color (#rrggbb) | `#446688` | Background of selected text. |
| `scrollback_lines` | int (-1..1000000) | `10000` | Lines kept above the screen; -1 means unlimited. |
| `scrollbar_position` | string | `right` | Where to show the scrollbar. |
|  |  | Values: `right`, `left`, `disabled` |  |
| `opacity` | float (0.1..1) | `1.0` | Window opacity when transparency is enabled. |
| `shell_command` | string | `/bin/bash` | Shell started in new terminals. |
| `notes_file` | string | `""` | Markdown file used by the notes commands; empty uses notes_dir. |
| `notes_dir` | string | `""` | Directory for Markdown notes; empty uses the data directory. |
| `notes_record_context` | bool | `true` | Record the command context next to new notes. |
| `notes_template` | string | `""` | Template prepended to new notes. |
| `editor_command` | string | `nano` | Editor used for notes and configuration files. |
| `snippets` | string map | `{}` | Named command snippets available to /snippet. |
| `osc133` | bool | `false` | Enable OSC 133 shell integration (prompt, command and exit markers). |
| `enable_transparency` | bool | `false` | Allow window transparency using the opacity setting. |
| `confirm_close` | bool | `true` | Ask before closing a tab with a running command. |
| `tab_title` | string | `Terminal` | Initial title of new tabs. |
| `tab_title_color` | color (#rrggbb) | `#ffffff` | Color of inactive tab titles. |
| `tab_active_title_color` | color (#rrggbb) | `#ffffff` | Color of the active tab title. |
| `encoding` | string | `UTF-8` | Default character encoding for new terminals. |
|  |  | Values: `UTF-8`, `ISO-8859-1`, `ISO-8859-15`, `UTF-16`, `UTF-16BE`, `UTF-16LE`, `CP1252`, `CP850`, `ASCII`, `KOI8-R`, `Shift_JIS`, `EUC-JP`, `GBK` |  |
| `auto_copy_selection` | bool | `true` | Copy a selection to the clipboard as soon as it is made. |
| `file_manager` | string | `""` | File manager used to open the notes directory. |
| `backspace_binding` | string | `ascii-del` | Bytes sent by Backspace. |
|  |  | Values: `auto`, `ascii-del`, `escape-sequence`, `control-h` |  |
| `delete_binding` | string | `escape-sequence` | Bytes sent by Delete. |
|  |  | Values: `auto`, `escape-sequence`, `ascii-del`, `control-h` |  |
| `custom_palette` | palette or null | `null` | Per-color overrides for the 16 ANSI colors. |
| `show_unsafe_paste_dialog` | bool | `true` | Warn before pasting text that contains control characters. |
| `show_tabs` | bool | `true` | Show the tab bar. |
| `show_menubar` | bool | `true` | Show the menu bar. |
| `show_toolbar` | bool | `true` | Show the window toolbar. |
| `show_stats` | bool | `false` | Show CPU, memory and disk statistics in the status bar. |
| `dynamic_title` | string | `replace` | How application titles combine with the tab title. |
|  |  | Values: `replace`, `before`, `after`, `hide` |  |
| `login_shell` | bool | `true` | Start the shell as a login shell. |
| `cursor_blink` | bool | `true` | Blink the cursor. |
| `scroll_on_output` | bool | `true` | Scroll to the bottom when a command produces output. |
| `scroll_on_keystroke` | bool | `true` | Scroll to the bottom when typing. |
| `allow_bold_text` | bool | `true` | Render bold text with a bold font. |
| `bold_is_bright` | bool | `false` | Render bold text with the bright variant of its color. |
| `sixel` | bool | `false` | Allow applications to draw inline Sixel images. |
| `smooth_scroll` | bool | `false` | Scroll by pixels instead of whole lines. |
| `word_char_exceptions` | string | `-./?%&#:_=+@~` | Extra characters treated as part of a word for double-click selection. |
| `terminal_columns` | int (40..300) | `80` | Initial width in character cells. |
| `terminal_rows` | int (10..120) | `24` | Initial height in character cells. |
| `window_padding_horizontal` | int (0..100) | `2` | Horizontal padding around the terminal, in pixels. |
| `window_padding_vertical` | int (0..100) | `2` | Vertical padding around the terminal, in pixels. |
| `bell_notification` | bool | `false` | Show a desktop notification when a background command rings the bell. |
| `pager_command` | string | `less -R` | Pager used to open command output. |
| `undercurl_style` | string | `single` | Shape used to draw curly underlines. |
|  |  | Values: `single`, `double`, `curly`, `dashed`, `dotted` |  |
| `broadcast_input` | bool | `false` | Send keyboard input to every pane in the window. |
| `active_profile` | string | `""` | Profile applied at startup; empty means none. |
| `session_restore` | bool | `true` | Restore tabs, splits and working directories on startup. |
| `history_enabled` | bool | `true` | Record commands in the SQLite history database. |
| `hint_mode_enabled` | bool | `true` | Enable hint mode for opening URLs, paths and hashes. |
| `vi_copy_mode_enabled` | bool | `false` | Enable VI-style keyboard copy mode. |
| `tmux_prefix_enabled` | bool | `true` | Enable the tmux-style Ctrl+B prefix in panes. |
| `tmux_prefix_key` | letter | `b` | Letter used with Ctrl as the tmux-style prefix. |
| `ssh_connection_sharing` | bool | `true` | Share SSH connections and enable keepalives through the bundled wrapper. |

## Limits

Limits are enforced before untrusted input reaches the UI:

| Limit | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Settings file / `-o` value | 4096 characters |
| Snippet map entries | 100 entries, 4096 characters each |
| Custom palette entries | 16 |
| OSC 133 FIFO line buffer | 64 KiB |
| Control API request frame | 8 MiB |
| Control API response frame | 64 MiB |
| PTY broker frame | 1024 KiB |
| PTY broker pending output | 4 MiB |
| PTY broker clients | 32 |
